inlines.v: WAGEL, noun 1. A name given in Cornwall to the martinazzo, dunghunter, or dungbird, a species of Larus or seagull. +, noun Mischievous merriment; sportive trick or gayety; sarcasm in good humor; frolicksome; as a company of waggish boys. 2. Done, made or laid in waggery or for sport; as a waggish trick.
